name: call_helper_and_return
description: Library routine that calls one helper routine and then returns, doing nothing else. It is reached through a pointer stored in the data section.

name: call_library_then_store_field
description: Calls an Amiga library function through the jump table of the library whose base pointer is stored 34 bytes into the first argument, at minus 294 bytes from that base, and passes the first argument along. It then writes the second argument into a field 148 bytes into the structure that call returned.

name: acquire_block_with_rollback
description: Obtains a block from one helper and, if that succeeds, passes it with the caller's arguments to a second helper. If the second step fails, it releases the block through a third helper and returns zero; otherwise it returns the block.

name: create_icon_from_record
description: Obtains a new structure from one helper, then has a second helper fill a stack buffer that is copied into the structure's 44-byte body and eight fields. If the fill fails it releases the structure and returns zero; otherwise, when one pointer field is set, it makes that linked structure point back to the new one and returns it.

name: copy_icon_fields_and_link
description: Copies a 44-byte block and eight fields from a stack-relative source into an icon structure whose address is held in a register. If one pointer field of that structure is set, it makes the structure that field points to refer back to it.

name: return_zero_immediately
description: Returns zero at once, with no register, memory or library operations.

name: pack_icon_record
description: Copies an icon structure's 44-byte block and eight fields into a local record that begins with two fixed constant values. It then passes that record to a helper routine together with the two arguments it received.

name: load_icon_from_info_file
description: Builds a path by appending the .info suffix to the given name, opens that file, and reads its 78-byte header. It checks the 16-bit icon signature and version one, then reads the icon's optional blocks into memory it allocates, returning zero if any step fails.

name: validate_and_read_icon_data
description: Checks the 16-bit icon signature and version one, zeroes two fields of the icon, then reads its data through the read helpers and fills its optional list and block fields. It returns zero when a read or allocation fails.

name: read_icon_optional_fields
description: Reads two 32-bit values into an icon structure, then reads or allocates data for each of its three optional pointer fields through the read helpers and a counted loop. It returns one when all reads succeed and zero otherwise.

name: read_longword_array_block
description: Reads 32-bit values into an array in a counted loop, then reads one further value into an optional field. It returns one on success and zero as soon as a read fails.

name: call_helper_then_return_zero
description: Calls one helper routine and then returns zero, doing no other work.

name: return_immediately
description: Returns at once without performing any operation.

name: save_icon_to_info_file
description: Allocates a 260-byte path buffer, builds a path ending in the .info suffix, and creates that file. It writes the icon's 78-byte header and its optional blocks, releases the buffer, and returns zero if any step fails.

name: write_icon_optional_blocks
description: Writes the icon's optional blocks to an open file, including a counted string list and a further data pointer. Each write is checked, and a saved field is restored before the routine returns.

name: write_icon_block_sequence
description: Writes an icon's optional string list and data pointer to an open file in sequence, checking each write. It restores a saved field and returns the result of the last check.

name: write_string_list_block
description: Totals the size of a NULL-terminated pointer list, writes that total, and then writes each string in the icon's string list preceded by its length plus one. It writes one optional extra string afterward and restores a saved field.

name: write_pointer_list_strings
description: Writes each string in a NULL-terminated pointer list to an open file, preceding each with its length plus one, then writes an optional extra string. It restores a saved field before returning.

name: walk_linked_node_list
description: Repeatedly asks a helper for the node following the one at a fixed offset, passing each node it finds to a second helper, until none is left. It returns nothing.

name: return_immediately
description: Returns immediately without performing any operation.

name: forward_call_with_offset
description: Calls another routine with the same first argument and with the second argument advanced by 140 bytes, then returns without using the result.

name: allocate_and_read_block
description: Allocates a cleared 168-byte block, calls helpers on two of its fields, and reads 168 bytes into it. It releases the block when the setup call fails, returns zero without releasing it when the read fails, and otherwise returns the block.

name: call_helper_and_return
description: Library routine that calls one helper routine and then returns, doing nothing else. It is reached through a pointer stored in the data section.

name: return_zero_immediately
description: Returns zero at once, without any operation.

name: refill_counter_and_store_pair
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter in a structure, calling a helper to refill the table when the counter reaches zero. It then stores two 32-bit values into the next 8-byte slot of the table the structure points to, returning one on success and zero when the refill fails.

name: decrement_counter_and_store_pair
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter in a structure and stores two 32-bit values from its arguments into the next 8-byte slot of the table the structure points to. It always returns one.

name: allocate_and_read_record
description: Allocates a cleared 94-byte block, reads 94 bytes into it through a helper, and then makes a further helper call that uses the block's field at offset 78. It releases the block and returns zero when a read fails, and returns zero if the final call fails.

name: return_immediately
description: Returns immediately without performing any operation.

name: call_library_then_return_zero
description: Calls one library function and then returns zero, doing no other work.

name: forward_call_with_offset
description: Calls another routine with the same first argument and with the second argument advanced by 78 bytes, then returns without using a result.

name: find_key_value_in_list
description: Walks a NULL-terminated list of strings looking for an entry that begins with the key followed by an equals sign. It returns the text after that equals sign, or zero when no entry matches.

name: return_zero_immediately
description: Returns zero at once, without any operation.

name: find_name_in_separated_list
description: Scans a string whose entries are separated by vertical bars for an entry equal to the given name. It returns one when a match is found and zero when the list ends.

name: scan_separated_list_for_name
description: Walks a vertical-bar-separated string, comparing each entry with a name of matching length, and returns one on a match or zero at the end of the string.

name: match_separated_list_entry
description: Walks a vertical-bar-separated string, checking each entry's length against a stored value before comparing its text. It returns one on a match and zero when the string ends.

name: search_separated_list_entry
description: Steps through a vertical-bar-separated string, comparing each entry's length and text with a stored target. It returns one when the target is found and zero when the string ends.

name: return_zero_immediately
description: Returns zero at once, without any operation.

name: build_copy_icon_name
description: Builds the name for a copied icon from the source name: it adds a copy prefix, or increments the number in an existing numbered copy prefix. It copies up to 30 characters into the destination and returns the destination pointer.

name: parse_copy_number
description: Reads a decimal number at a fixed offset into the name, requiring the text ' of ' after it, and then makes two calls on every path. Nothing is returned.

name: parse_copy_number_digits
description: Reads a run of decimal digits from the text pointer, building up a number, and then checks for the text ' of ' after the digits. It makes two calls on each path and returns nothing.

name: read_copy_number_digits
description: Accumulates decimal digits from the text into a number, then checks for the text ' of ' after them. It makes two calls on each path and returns nothing.

name: convert_decimal_digit
description: Returns the value of a decimal digit character, from 0 to 9, or minus one for any other character.

name: call_library_function_no_args
description: Calls an Amiga library function at minus 198 bytes from the library base held in a global variable, passing no arguments and returning nothing.

name: acquire_block_with_rollback
description: Obtains a block from one helper and, if that succeeds, passes it with the caller's arguments to a second helper. If the second step fails, it releases the block through a third helper and returns zero; otherwise it returns the block.

name: allocate_cleared_block_for_slot
description: Allocates a cleared 96-byte block, stores the value 10 in one of its fields and in the caller's 16-bit value, and passes the block to a helper together with the address just after that value. It returns true when the allocation succeeded.

name: return_zero_immediately
description: Returns zero at once, without any operation.

name: verify_helper_result_matches
description: Calls a helper with its second, third and fourth arguments and returns the fourth argument when the helper's result equals it, or zero otherwise.

name: return_immediately
description: Returns immediately without performing any operation.

name: verify_helper_result_matches
description: Calls a helper with its second, third and fourth arguments and returns the fourth argument when the helper's result equals it, or zero otherwise.

name: return_immediately
description: Returns immediately without performing any operation.

name: divide_unsigned_longword
description: Divides a 32-bit unsigned dividend by a divisor and returns the quotient and remainder together. A divisor of 65536 or more uses a 16-step shift-and-subtract loop, while smaller divisors use the processor's 16-bit divide.

name: run_restoring_division_loop
description: Runs the 16-step shift-and-subtract core of a division, shifting a 32-bit value left one bit at a time and subtracting the divisor from the upper half whenever that half is at least the divisor. It returns nothing and leaves its results in registers.

name: multiply_32_bit_integers
description: Computes the low 32 bits of the product of two 32-bit values from 16-bit partial products. It returns that product in the upper half of its result, with the second value's halves swapped in the lower half.

name: call_raw_do_fmt_entry
description: Calls the Exec library's RawDoFmt routine through its entry 522 bytes below the library base held in a global variable, passing no arguments and returning nothing.

name: store_byte_at_pointer
description: Stores the low byte of one register at the address held in another register, then returns. It appears to be the per-character output step for a formatting routine.

name: measure_c_string_length
description: Counts the characters before the terminating zero byte of a string and returns that length.

name: find_character_in_string
description: Returns a pointer to the first occurrence of the given character in a zero-terminated string, or zero if the character is not found before the terminator.

name: return_zero_immediately
description: Returns zero at once, without any operation.

name: copy_zero_terminated_string
description: Copies bytes from a source string to a destination, including the terminating zero byte, and returns nothing.

name: append_zero_terminated_string
description: Finds the terminating zero byte of the destination string and copies the source string, including its own terminator, from that point. It returns nothing.

name: compare_bounded_strings
description: Compares two strings for at most the given number of characters. It returns zero when they match over that span or end together, and one at the first differing character.

name: return_one_immediately
description: Returns one at once, without any operation.

name: scan_bounded_string_end
description: Walks a string for at most the given number of characters, and when it reaches the terminating zero byte it makes one helper call before returning. Nothing is returned.

name: call_helper_and_return
description: Calls one helper routine and then returns, doing nothing else. It is reached through a pointer stored in the data section.

name: copy_string_with_zero_padding
description: Copies a zero-terminated string into a buffer of the given length, copying at most that many bytes. If the terminator is reached first, it clears the rest of the buffer with zero bytes.

name: return_immediately
description: Returns immediately without performing any operation.

name: initialize_empty_list
description: Sets up an empty list header: its head points at the tail slot after it, the tail is cleared, and the tail predecessor points back at the header. It contains no entries.

name: process_record_if_present
description: Returns one when the record pointer is null. Otherwise it reads a 20-byte header through a helper and, if that succeeds, makes two more calls, including one that processes the pointer stored 10 bytes into the record; it returns zero when the header read fails.

name: process_linked_record_chain
description: Walks a chain of records linked through the pointer at offset 12 of each record. For each record it reads a 16-byte header, then processes the entries at offset 8 with a size of four bytes times the byte at offset 7; it returns one at the end of the chain and zero if any step fails.

name: return_one_immediately
description: Returns one at once, without any operation.

name: return_zero_immediately
description: Returns zero at once, without any operation.

name: allocate_and_load_header_record
description: Allocates a cleared 20-byte record and reads it through a helper, then reads a 2-byte-sized item through a second helper and stores the result at offset 10. It returns the record on success, minus one if a step fails, and zero when the flag argument is zero.

name: return_minus_one_immediately
description: Returns minus one at once, without any operation.

name: allocate_and_link_record_chain
description: Allocates cleared 16-byte records one after another, reads each header through a helper, and links each new record to the previous one at offset 12. For each record it obtains a block at offset 8 and fills it with data sized by the byte at offset 7, returning minus one if any step fails.

name: read_linked_record_chain
description: Reads a chain of linked records through helper calls, storing each record's link at a fixed offset, and returns a saved record pointer when the chain ends. It returns minus one if any read fails.

name: return_immediately
description: Returns immediately without performing any operation.

name: return_minus_one_immediately
description: Returns minus one at once, without any operation.

name: make_and_add_library_base
description: Creates a library base with the Exec MakeLibrary routine, stores the library's own base pointer at offset 34 and the supplied pointer at offset 38, and registers it with AddLibrary. It returns minus one on success and zero when the base cannot be made.

name: increment_counter_and_clear_flag
description: Increments a 16-bit counter at offset 32 of the structure and clears the bit with value 32 in the byte at offset 14. It returns nothing.

name: decrement_counter_and_call
description: Decrements the 16-bit counter at offset 32 of the structure. When the counter reaches zero and bit 32 of the byte at offset 14 is set, it calls a helper and returns its result; otherwise it returns zero.

name: unlink_node_or_set_flag
description: When the short at offset 8 is zero, it removes the node from its list by linking its neighbours together, then calls a library function and returns the value at offset 38. Otherwise it sets bit 32 in the byte at offset 14 and returns zero.

name: unlink_node_then_call_library
description: Removes the node held in a register from its list by linking its neighbours together, then calls the library function at minus 210 bytes from the library base and returns the value stored at offset 38 of the node.

name: return_zero_immediately
description: Returns zero at once, without any operation.

name: parse_hash_marked_text
description: Blank-fills a 108-byte local buffer, then scans a text string, treating the hash character as a marker and the space character as a separator. It calls helpers for each field and returns a 16-bit result when scanning ends.

name: widen_low_word_value
description: Returns the low 16-bit word of a register, sign-extended to a full value, and does nothing else.

name: store_terminator_and_return_word
description: Calls one helper, writes a zero byte just before the address register's position to terminate the text, and returns the 16-bit result widened to a full value.

name: scan_hash_marked_fields
description: Scans a text string field by field, stopping at a hash character and skipping spaces, with helper calls for each field. It returns a 16-bit result and writes a zero terminator at the end of the scanned text.

name: scan_text_until_hash
description: Scans a text string until a hash character, skipping spaces between fields and calling helpers for each field. It writes a zero byte at the end of the scanned text and returns a 16-bit result.

name: scan_escape_delimited_text
description: Scans a string character by character, stopping at a backslash or a backquote, and calls helpers at each stop. It returns once both helper checks succeed.

name: skip_to_escape_or_backquote
description: Advances through a string until it finds a backslash or a backquote, then calls helpers for that match. It returns when the final helper check succeeds.

name: return_immediately
description: Returns immediately without performing any operation.

name: match_bracketed_pattern
description: Skips forward to an opening bracket in the rule, then compares the text against the characters that follow it until the closing bracket is reached. It returns when the bracket is closed or a character differs.

name: match_left_context_backwards
description: Walks backward through the input text, consulting a per-character class table to decide which characters take part, and compares each one with the text before the match point. It returns on a mismatch or when the start of the text is reached.

name: return_immediately
description: Returns immediately without performing any operation.

name: match_backward_character_run
description: Steps backward through the input while characters belong to a class in the table, comparing each one with the text before the match point. It returns when the input is exhausted or a mismatch occurs.

name: match_forward_until_equals
description: Compares text forward against the rule characters and stops at an equals sign, consulting a per-character class table on each step. It returns without a result.

name: match_text_until_equals
description: Compares rule text with the input forward until an equals sign, using a per-character class table to decide when to stop comparing. It returns without a result.

name: emit_rule_text_segment
description: Finds the end of a delimited segment of rule text and copies it to the output buffer when it fits. When it does not fit, it trims the output back to a boundary character, and it returns the segment length and an adjusted position.

name: copy_delimited_rule_segment
description: Copies a delimited segment of rule text into the output buffer, then sets a status flag when the segment's last character has a class flag set. The flag is cleared again when the following character is a backquote.

name: copy_rule_bytes_with_flag
description: Copies a counted run of rule bytes into the output buffer, then sets the lowest bit of a status byte when the last byte has a class flag, clearing that bit again if the next byte is a backquote. It returns its first register unchanged.

name: terminate_output_at_boundary
description: Moves back from the output position to the nearest character with the boundary class, and writes a zero byte there to end the output. It returns nothing.

name: dispatch_special_character_handler
description: Looks up a character in a table of special punctuation characters and calls the handler stored in the matching table slot. It returns nothing.

name: return_immediately
description: Returns immediately without performing any operation.

name: return_immediately
description: Returns immediately without performing any operation.

name: call_helper_and_return
description: Calls one helper routine and then returns, doing nothing else. It is reached through a pointer stored in the data section.

name: call_helper_while_flag_set
description: Calls one helper, then repeatedly calls it again while bit 32 of a register remains set. It returns nothing.

name: call_helper_and_return
description: Calls one helper routine and then returns, doing nothing else. It is reached through a pointer stored in the data section.

name: check_status_character_code
description: Calls a helper, and when bit 32 of a status register is set it calls the helper once more and compares the returned character with two letter codes. It returns nothing in every case.

name: return_immediately
description: Returns immediately without performing any operation.

name: match_english_suffix_letters
description: Checks the input for letter sequences that form common English endings, including E followed by S, D or R, L followed by Y, and N followed by G. A status bit decides which of these checks apply, and it returns nothing.

name: match_ng_letter_sequence
description: Checks the input for the letters N and G, and then for an S when a status bit is set, using that bit to decide which checks apply. It returns nothing.

name: return_immediately
description: Returns immediately without performing any operation.

description: Calls one helper routine and then returns, doing nothing else. It is reached through a pointer stored in the data section.

description: Calls one helper routine and then returns, doing nothing else. It is reached through a pointer stored in the data section.

name: call_helper_and_return
description: Calls one helper routine and then returns, doing nothing else. It is reached through a pointer stored in the data section.

name: call_helper_while_flag_set
description: Calls one helper repeatedly while bit 32 of a register remains set. It returns nothing.

name: call_helper_and_return
description: Calls one helper routine and then returns, doing nothing else. It is reached through a pointer stored in the data section.

name: call_helper_while_bit_set
description: Calls one helper repeatedly while bit 2 of a register remains set. It returns nothing.

name: call_helper_then_return
description: Calls one helper routine and returns. A status-bit test that follows has no effect on the result.

name: return_immediately
description: Returns immediately without performing any operation.

name: normalize_input_text_buffer
description: Copies input text into a buffer one character at a time, converting control characters, DEL and right brackets to spaces and lowercase letters to capitals. It stops at a space, and when more than 100 characters are read it returns minus three.

name: write_space_before_cursor
description: Writes a space character two bytes before the address held in a register. It returns nothing.

name: insert_diphthong_marker
description: When one of fifteen two-letter vowel pairs from a fixed list appears in the buffer, shifts the rest of the buffer up by one byte and inserts the character 4 right after the pair. It returns nothing.

name: shift_in_marker_character
description: Shifts buffer contents up by one byte from a position, writes the character 4 into the gap, and advances the stored position past it. It returns its argument unchanged.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Only a single instruction that could not be decoded, so this entry holds no usable behaviour.

name: store_registers_into_globals
description: Saves the frame and data register values into global variables, writes the address register value at offset 34 of the structure held in another register, and stores that address value in a further global. It returns nothing.

name: call_helper_and_return
description: Calls one helper routine and then returns, doing nothing else. It is reached through a pointer stored in the data section.

name: return_immediately
description: Returns immediately without performing any operation.

name: call_helper_and_return
description: Calls one helper routine and then returns, doing nothing else. It is reached through a pointer stored in the data section.

name: clear_flag_and_increment_counter
description: Clears bit 8 in the byte at offset 14 of the structure and increments the 16-bit counter at offset 32. It returns the structure pointer unchanged.

name: release_block_when_counter_zero
description: When the counter at offset 32 of the structure is zero, it calls a helper on the structure, releases the memory region computed from its offsets 16 and 18 through another helper, and makes a final call. Otherwise it sets bit 8 at offset 14, calls a helper, and returns zero.

name: release_block_and_return_global
description: Reads a saved global value, calls a helper, releases the memory region computed from the structure's fields at offsets 16 and 18 through another helper, makes a further call, and returns the saved value.

name: decrement_counter_then_release
description: Decrements the 16-bit counter at offset 32 of the structure. When it reaches zero and bit 8 of the byte at offset 14 is set, it calls a helper and returns its result; otherwise it returns zero.

name: return_zero_immediately
description: Returns zero at once, without any operation.

name: invoke_helpers_for_nonzero_pointers
description: Calls a helper with the third argument when it is non-zero, and with the second argument and the value one when that is non-zero, and also calls a helper for each of several global pointers that are non-zero. It returns nothing.

name: allocate_info_library_structures
description: Allocates a cleared 812-byte block and stores pointers to its internal fields in several global variables. It then passes those fields to a helper, and returns zero when the allocation fails.

name: set_info_structure_pointers
description: Stores pointers to offsets inside a structure into several global variables, each computed from the structure's first pointer field. It passes some of those areas to a helper with a size of 12 bytes and returns a constant after the setup calls.

name: open_system_libraries_or_fail
description: Opens four system libraries through a helper, storing each base in a global variable, and reports error code 3, 4 or 5 through another helper if one fails. It returns one when all four open and zero otherwise.

name: open_three_libraries_or_fail
description: Opens three libraries through a function pointer, storing each base in a global variable, and reports error code 3, 4 or 5 through a second pointer when one fails. It returns one when all three open and zero otherwise.

name: open_two_libraries_or_fail
description: Opens two libraries through a function pointer, storing each base in a global variable, and reports error code 4 or 5 through a second pointer when one fails. It returns one when both open and zero otherwise.

name: open_graphics_library_or_fail
description: Opens the graphics library through a function pointer and stores its base in a global variable. If the open fails it reports error code 5 through a second pointer, and it returns whether the library opened.

name: return_one_immediately
description: Returns one at once, without any operation.

name: get_linked_structure_value
description: Returns the 32-bit value at offset 164 of the structure held in a global pointer when that field is set. Otherwise it reads offset 442 from a structure reached through the pointer at offset 76, or offset 56 for other types, and returns zero when the pointer is null or the type byte is seven.

name: get_linked_structure_value_direct
description: Returns the 32-bit value at offset 164 of the structure held in an address register when that field is set. Otherwise it reads offset 442 from a structure reached through the pointer at offset 76, or offset 56 for other types, and returns zero when the type byte is seven.

name: get_structure_info_value
description: Returns the value at offset 164 of the structure held in an address register when that field is set. Otherwise it reads offset 442 from the structure reached through the pointer at offset 76 for type one, or through offset 56 for other types, returning zero when that pointer is null.

name: read_linked_info_value
description: Reads offset 442 of a structure reached through the pointer at offset 76, either of the structure in one address register or of a second structure held in another register, depending on a type byte. It returns zero when the second structure pointer is null and the type is not one.

name: read_info_value_from_pointer
description: Returns offset 442 of the structure reached through offset 76 of the structure held in an address register, or zero when that register is null.

name: lookup_info_file_by_name
description: Builds a 116-byte name buffer from a global name or from a pointer stored in the structure, then looks it up through helpers. It returns the value found, or for a type-one entry falls back to the value at offset 442 of the structure at offset 76.

name: lookup_entry_name_with_fallback
description: Copies the structure's name pointer into a 116-byte stack buffer and looks it up through a helper. When the lookup fails for a type-one entry, it returns the value at offset 442 of the structure at offset 76 and sets a fallback flag; otherwise it returns the lookup result and clears that flag.

name: allocate_info_entry_buffers
description: Allocates a cleared 36-byte block and a cleared 260-byte buffer, then sizes a further buffer from a stored count with a minimum of 256 and allocates it cleared. It copies name data through helpers and returns zero when a step fails.

name: populate_info_entry_block
description: Allocates an entry block through a helper, copies its name, and sets a stored count to at least 256 before allocating a further buffer. It copies data into that buffer and stores the results in the entry's fields, returning zero when a step fails.

name: populate_info_entry_fields
description: Copies a name into an entry block, sets its count to at least 256, and allocates a buffer for it when possible. It returns one after the setup succeeds and zero otherwise.

name: populate_info_entry_checked
description: Runs the same entry setup as its sibling only when an initial check passes. It returns one on success and zero otherwise.

name: populate_info_entry_body
description: Copies a name into the entry, sets its count to at least 256, and allocates a buffer that is filled from the source data. It returns true when the buffer was allocated.

name: copy_info_entry_fields
description: Stores two source field values in the destination entry, passes the entry's buffer and a source value to a helper, and returns one.

name: initialize_info_library_state
description: Clears several global pointers, records the structure argument as the current entry, and allocates a cleared 246-byte block. It reports error codes 5, 6 or 7 through a helper when a step fails.

name: finish_info_entry_with_status
description: Performs setup steps on an entry and then reports the outcome through a callback pointer: status zero on success, or status 5, 7 or 1 on failure. It returns nothing.

name: report_info_entry_outcome
description: Looks up a value and, on success, copies the entry's fields and reports status zero through a callback pointer. A failed lookup, allocation or check reports status 5, 7 or 1 instead.

name: report_info_entry_result
description: Allocates an entry value and copies fields into it, reporting the outcome through a callback pointer: status zero on success, one when a check fails, and seven when the allocation fails.

name: report_info_entry_status
description: Copies fields and runs a check, reporting status one through a callback pointer when the check fails and status zero after the final copy steps otherwise. It returns nothing.

name: report_entry_status_on_check
description: Runs one check on an entry and reports status one through a callback pointer when it fails, or status zero after copying fields when it passes. It returns nothing.

name: report_status_after_check
description: Runs one check and reports status one through a callback pointer on failure, or status zero after the copy steps on success. It returns nothing.

name: run_status_callback_chain
description: Runs an optional step, then four further steps, and finishes with an indirect call that reports status zero through a callback pointer. It returns nothing.

name: create_info_layout_object
description: Fills a local record with fixed position and size values and a pointer to the global text, then passes it to a helper. If that helper returns an object, it passes the object with a mask and the global text to a second helper, and returns the object.

name: dispatch_info_entry_by_type
description: Switches on a 16-bit type code at offset 38 of a nested structure and performs the matching action: most cases call a helper with stored values, one case stores a pointer into the entry, and a few return fixed codes of zero or one. It returns one for unlisted codes.

name: return_one_immediately
description: Returns one at once, without any operation.

name: toggle_info_status_bit
description: Maps a type code from 6 to 9 to one of the bit values eight, four, two and one, and toggles that bit in a status word of the entry; other codes leave the word unchanged. It then passes a value from the first argument to a helper and returns nothing.
